create.name: Anand Mehrotra
create.bio:
Anand Mehrotra grew up in Rishikesh and still teaches there, at the foot of the Himalayas. As a boy he learned from his guru, known simply as Maharaji, in the oral way of the Himalayan Yog-Vedanta tradition, so that study of the scriptures, meditation and daily sadhana were part of ordinary family life. In 2012 he set out Sattva Yoga, his own integrated method, which puts kriya and kundalini techniques, pranayama, flowing asana, mantra, stillness, devotion and wisdom teaching into a single practice rather than treating them as separate styles.

He founded Sattva Yoga Academy in Rishikesh, where he and his team run multi-week teacher trainings and retreats in English, and the online platform Sattva Connect, which streams live classes and hosts his recorded courses on dharma, the Goddess tradition and the nature of consciousness. His books, published by Sattva Publications, include This Is That and That Is This, a two-part reading of Patanjali's Yoga Sutras, a commentary on the Isha Upanishad and a set of reflections on the Bhagavad Gita. He also appears in the films The Highest Pass and Road to Dharma, which follow his motorcycle journeys through the high Himalayas, and he supports village education and farming projects around Rishikesh.

books.title: This Is That: Patanjali's Yoga Sutras Padas 1 and 2
books.author: Anand Mehrotra
books.description: The first of his two volumes on the Yoga Sutras, working through the opening two chapters as a guide to practice rather than as abstract philosophy. It reads Patanjali as a map for discovering one's own nature.

courses.title: Sattva 200-Hour Yoga Teacher Training in Rishikesh
courses.description: A residential foundational teacher training at Sattva Yoga Academy covering asana, kriya, pranayama, meditation and yogic philosophy in the Sattva method. Accommodation at the academy is included in the fee.

courses.title: Sattva Connect Membership
courses.description: Monthly or yearly access to his online platform, with a large library of recorded classes, daily live sessions and wisdom series. A free trial week is offered.
courses.price: $21 USD per month or $210 USD per year

courses.title: Saundarya Lahari
courses.description: A recorded course in 19 video chapters on the hymn attributed to Adi Shankaracharya, with mantra, the Sri Yantra and the Shiva-Shakti teachings. Lifetime access.

courses.title: Living a Life of Purpose
courses.description: A wisdom series recorded on his 2023 Australian tour, looking at dharma and the yogic aims of life as a basis for living with direction. Lifetime access.

courses.title: Warrior of Wisdom
courses.description: A recorded twelve-day online immersion on states of consciousness, karma and moving from reaction to considered response. Lifetime access to the sessions.
